description: Create a new diagram from Mermaid source — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, mind maps, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, and anything else Mermaid supports. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

code.description: Mermaid diagram source, e.g. "flowchart TD\n  A --> B".

is_public.description: Public diagrams can be read (not edited) by anyone with the link.

theme_id.description: One of the Diagram Maker theme ids, e.g. "minimal-flat", "dark-console", "neon", "cartoon". Omit to keep the current theme.

name: create_diagram
